class.name: Achievements
class.description: Achievements are kept with the player's saves, so they reach the platforms the player plays on later (and their account, once they add an email), and are sent to the platform the game is running on: Steam, Game Center or Play Games. Each achievement's name on a platform is [code]achievements/<id>/<platform>[/code] in Project Settings, where the platform is [code]steam[/code], [code]game_center[/code] or [code]play_games[/code]; without one, the platform uses the same ID. [codeblock] Achievements.unlock("first_delivery") Achievements.set_progress("deliveries", 3, 10) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_all
method.description: Returns every achievement the player has made progress on, wherever they did, as [code]{id: progress}[/code] with progress from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]. It includes achievements the platform had that the game never reported here.

method.name: get_progress
method.description: Returns the progress towards an achievement, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code] ([code]1[/code] is unlocked).

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the platform the game runs on has achievements (Steam, Game Center or Play Games). Elsewhere they're still kept with the player's saves, for later.

method.name: set_progress
method.description: Records progress towards an achievement, unlocking it when [param current] reaches [param total]. Progress only goes up. Game Center shows it as a percentage and Play Games for incremental achievements; on Steam, [code]achievements/<id>/steam_stat[/code] names the stat to set to [param current].

method.name: show
method.description: Opens the platform's achievements screen: Steam's overlay, Game Center's or Play Games'.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method get_all] changed: the player made progress, or achievements arrived from the platform or another device.
